custom_fields.description: Short name of this group in the URL, for example jobber-drills. Use a-z, 0-9 and hyphens. Empty: made from the Item Group name. The route changes in a background job, and the old route redirects to the new one.
custom_fields.label: Website Slug
custom_fields.name: Item Group-website_slug

custom_fields.description: Put the Website Slug of this group in the URL of each descendant group. RIGPL Settings > Website Route Max Depth limits the number of groups in a URL.
custom_fields.label: Include in URL
custom_fields.name: Item Group-include_in_url
